evidence: Clamps the driver ID and selects the appropriate block of g_aiNames.
Converts whole and fractional centiseconds to 16.16 seconds.
comment: Converts a time in hundredths of a second into 16.16 seconds.

evidence: Restores saved velocities, orientation and flags, advances history and rebuilds body vectors and corners.
comment: Resets a car's physics state from a saved one (used when the body is put back on the road): copies the stored fields and rebuilds the matrix-derived vectors of the body.

evidence: Copies body and world matrix basis/position into the two car body scene nodes.
comment: Copies the car's body and world matrices into the local transform of its two body scene nodes.

evidence: Clamps absolute X/Z components to half extents and optionally clamps Y.
comment: Clamps the magnitude of each component of v to limit (y only when clampY).

evidence: Bounds X/Z to eight physics-scale units and Y to four; used on the angular contact correction.
comment: Clamps a vector to the scaled limits: eight units on X/Z, four on Y.

evidence: Reads the generic file buffer, records its size and reports success.
Clears didFileLoad then sets it on a successful file read into the GenericFile record.
Inverts the view matrix, transforms the world point and projects it to screen coordinates.
comment: Projects a world point to screen pixels through the view node's camera (off-screen marker -100,-100 when behind the camera).

evidence: Builds available route entries, selects the stored route and measures the scroller widths.
comment: Lays out the route scroller and measures the available entries.

evidence: Updates the championship entry limit and current event, then optionally rebuilds its route scroller.
comment: Change callback of the championship entry screens. Its external byte state preserves the original byte loads without changing the other screen callbacks.
